items.title: Russia says Crimean Bridge restoration plans are finalized
items.summary: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin said all design decisions for restoring the Crimean Bridge have been made, with schedules, responsibilities and required materials determined.

items.title: Four reported dead following strike in occupied Makiivka
items.summary: Russian-appointed authorities and emergency services reported that four people died after a residential building collapsed following a strike in Makiivka. The circumstances have not been independently verified.

items.title: Meloni reportedly warns Ukraine of growing opposition to military aid
items.summary: According to Italian press reporting, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned President Volodymyr Zelensky that the reported incident off Libya could make continued Italian assistance more difficult amid parliamentary opposition.

items.title: Poland reportedly signs $300 million military AI agreement
items.summary: Poland reportedly signed a five-year agreement with US technology company Palantir to integrate artificial intelligence into its armed forces.
